aiSync.proxyTestHint: Check the current address, latency and exit region. Uses the form without saving the provider or sending its keys.
aiSync.warmupHint: Send the smallest request to start an idle plan window. Warming all leaves disabled accounts and running windows unchanged.
aiSync.warmSaveFirst: Save this account provider before warming its accounts.
aiSync.codexClientHint: Choose which client requests to ChatGPT accounts say they come from. This applies to every configured ChatGPT account, including model lists and allowance reads.
aiSync.bareModelIDsHint: Let clients choose IDs such as gpt-6. Only replaces the provider/model IDs each bare ID can reach. Entries it cannot replace keep their original IDs.
aiSync.maxImagesHint: Set a cap by model; * covers all models. 0 follows the vendor. Older images are removed above the cap, while images in the latest user message are kept.
aiSync.claudeNoExtraUsage: Do not use Claude extra usage
aiSync.claudeNoExtraUsageHint: When a plan window is used up, pause this account and continue with other available accounts.
aiSync.socketHint: The default uses WebSocket automatically on OpenAI's API and HTTP elsewhere. Automatic mode temporarily uses HTTP after a refused connection.
aiSync.noAccountWindows: No account window can be read now
aiSync.pasteKeysHint: Use one per line, or separate with commas, semicolons or spaces. Existing keys are kept. Save to apply new keys.
aiSync.accountWithdrawn: This account adapter is withdrawn for new users
aiSync.antigravityWithdrawal: Upstream notes that Google may suspend accounts called through this adapter. Existing sign-ins still work. Use Antigravity (local agy CLI) for new accounts.
aiSync.antigravityMoveHint: Migration checks accounts with the installed official agy and keeps the old sign-ins. Install official agy first; WinOne does not install the client automatically.
aiSync.accountMovePartial: Some accounts could not be moved. The original provider is unchanged. Check each outcome and retry.
aiSync.accountMoveSave: Accounts moved. Save the provider, then fetch the local agy model list.
aiSync.keyAutoProbe: Checking in the background; resumes when the provider answers again.
aiSync.totalResetManual: This total never resets automatically. Reset starts counting again from now.
aiSync.accountResetUnknown: Resets with the account's window; its reset time cannot be read now.
aiSync.accountResetUnknownSpent: Allowance spent; wait for the account's window to reset. Its reset time cannot be read now.
